player_prompt.intro:
Kemm ad ikkan Player {player_id} di SimpleTak.
Di tabdart, azruy nnek yettili d '{player_stone}' yerna azruy n umsawal nnek yettili d '{opponent_stone}'.

Di tur nnek, fayn yiwen usqa (s uṭṭun-is) yerna ṛẓ azruy nnek dinna.
Amṭṭal, '[12]' ṛẓ azruy nnek di usqa 12.

Tigzi nnek ad tili tawwuri n azruy nnek iqqan ṭṭṛiq iqqan n azruy nnek i yeqqan snat tiggiwin n tabdart (s uflla-s-ufellay nɣ s uẓelmaḍ-s-azelmaṭ).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Aṭas n celulle ameqran {cell_num}. Ilaqa ad yili gar n 0 d {max_board_num}.

action.placement: Imcawi {current_player_id} yenɣa aseɛdu nnes ({symbol}) deg celulle {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Imcawi {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') yenɣa ijehden n tizi nniḍen!
outcome.draw: ⵢⵓⵡⵉ ⵓⵙⵇⵇⵉⵎ ⴰⴽⴽ. ⵉⴳⴰ ⵢⴰⵏ ⵓⴽⵛⵛⵓⵎ!
